<div class="health-check" id="health-container">

 <h2>🏥 فحص صحة فواتير المبيعات</h2>

 <div style="text-align:center">

   <select id="year-filter" onchange="loadHealthCheck()">

     <option value="2026" selected>2026</option>

     <option value="2025">2025</option>

   </select>

</div>


<script>

function loadHealthCheck() {

 var year = document.getElementById('year-filter').value;

 document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'block';

 document.getElementById('results').style.display = 'none';


 frappe.call({

   method: 'frappe.client.get_list',

   args: {

     doctype: 'Sales Invoice',

     filters: [['docstatus','=',1],['posting_date','>=',year+'-01-01'],['posting_date','<=',year+'-12-31']],

     fields: ['count(name) as total'],

     limit_page_length: 0

   },

   async: true,

   callback: function(r) {

     var total_inv = r.message[0].total;

     loadDetails(year, total_inv);

   }

 });

}


function loadDetails(year, total_inv) {

 frappe.call({

   method: 'frappe.client.get_list',

   type: 'GET',

   args: {

     doctype: 'Sales Invoice',

     filters: [['docstatus','=',1],['posting_date','>=',year+'-01-01'],['posting_date','<=',year+'-12-31']],

     fields: ['name'],

     limit_page_length: 0

   },

   async: true,

   callback: function() {

     // Get invoices without sales team

     frappe.call({

       method: 'frappe.client.get_list',

       args: {

         doctype: 'Sales Invoice',

         filters: [['docstatus','=',1],['posting_date','>=',year+'-01-01'],['posting_date','<=',year+'-12-31']],

         fields: ['name','owner','posting_date','customer'],

         limit_page_length: 0

       },

       callback: function(all) {

         var all_invoices = all.message;

         // Now get which ones have sales team

         frappe.call({

           method: 'frappe.client.get_list',

           args: {

             doctype: 'Sales Team',

             filters: [['parenttype','=','Sales Invoice']],

             fields: ['distinct parent as name'],

             limit_page_length: 0

           },

           callback: function(st) {

             var with_team = {};

             (st.message || []).forEach(function(r) { with_team[r.name] = true; });


             var no_team = all_invoices.filter(function(inv) { return !with_team[inv.name]; });

             var ok_count = all_invoices.length - no_team.length;


             var html = '<div class="stats-row">';

             html += '<div class="stat-box ' + (no_team.length === 0 ? 'stat-ok' : 'stat-bad') + '">';

             html += '<div class="stat-number">' + no_team.length + '</div>';

             html += '<div class="stat-label">فواتير بدون فريق مبيعات</div></div>';

             html += '<div class="stat-box stat-ok">';

             html += '<div class="stat-number">' + ok_count + '</div>';

             html += '<div class="stat-label">فواتير سليمة</div></div>';

             html += '<div class="stat-box stat-warn">';

             html += '<div class="stat-number">' + all_invoices.length + '</div>';

             html += '<div class="stat-label">إجمالي الفواتير</div></div>';

function stripInline(url){
  if(!url)return 0;
  var imgs=elEd.querySelectorAll("img"),n=0,kill=[];
  for(var i=0;i<imgs.length;i++){
    var s=imgs[i].getAttribute("src")||"";

function insertAtCursor(html){

    var rg=sel.getRangeAt(0);rg.deleteContents();
    var tmp=document.createElement("div");tmp.innerHTML=html;
    var frag=document.createDocumentFragment(),n;
    while((n=tmp.firstChild))frag.appendChild(n);
    var last=frag.lastChild;
    rg.insertNode(frag);
    if(last){rg.setStartAfter(last);rg.setEndAfter(last);sel.removeAllRanges();sel.addRange(rg);}
  }else{

function stamp(ext){
  var d=new Date();
  function p(x){return (x<10?"0":"")+x;}
  return "paste_"+d.getFullYear()+p(d.getMonth()+1)+p(d.getDate())+"_"+
         p(d.getHours())+p(d.getMinutes())+p(d.getSeconds())+"_"+
         Math.floor(Math.random()*9000+1000)+ext;
}
function extOf(type){
  if(type.indexOf("png")>-1)return ".png";
  if(type.indexOf("jpeg")>-1||type.indexOf("jpg")>-1)return ".jpg";
  if(type.indexOf("gif")>-1)return ".gif";
  if(type.indexOf("webp")>-1)return ".webp";
  if(type.indexOf("bmp")>-1)return ".bmp";

}
function handleImageBlobs(blobs){

    var fname=(b.name&&b.name.indexOf(".")>-1)?b.name:stamp(extOf(b.type||""));

      insertAtCursor('<img src="'+d.file_url+'">');
      done++;

    }).then(next).catch(function(e){

var SHEET=[],SDIRTY=false,STMR=null;
var elST=document.getElementById("tn-stable"),elSI=document.getElementById("sh-info");
function colName(i){
  var s="";
  i=i+1;
  while(i>0){var m=(i-1)%26;s=String.fromCharCode(65+m)+s;i=Math.floor((i-1)/26);}
  return s;
}
function loadSheet(raw){
  SHEET=[];
  if(raw){
    try{SHEET=JSON.parse(raw)||[];}catch(e){SHEET=[];}
  }
  if(!SHEET.length){
    var r,c;
    for(r=0;r<12;r++){
      var row=[];
      for(c=0;c<6;c++)row.push("");
      SHEET.push(row);
    }
  }
  SDIRTY=false;
  renderSheet();
}
function renderSheet(){
  var w=0,r,c;
  SHEET.forEach(function(row){if(row.length>w)w=row.length;});
  if(w<1)w=1;
  var s='<thead><tr><th class="rh"></th>';
  for(c=0;c<w;c++)s+='<th>'+colName(c)+'</th>';
  s+='</tr></thead><tbody>';
  for(r=0;r<SHEET.length;r++){
    s+='<tr><td class="rh">'+(r+1)+'</td>';
    for(c=0;c<w;c++){
      var v=SHEET[r][c];
      v=(v===undefined||v===null)?"":String(v);
      var isn=v!==""&&!isNaN(Number(v.split(",").join("")));
      s+='<td class="'+(isn?"numv":"")+'"><input data-r="'+r+'" data-c="'+c+'" value="'+esc(v)+'"></td>';
    }
    s+='</tr>';
  }
  elST.innerHTML=s+'</tbody>';
  elSI.textContent=SHEET.length+" x "+w;
  elST.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(function(inp){
    inp.oninput=function(){
      var rr=parseInt(inp.dataset.r,10),cc=parseInt(inp.dataset.c,10);
      while(SHEET[rr].length<=cc)SHEET[rr].push("");
      SHEET[rr][cc]=inp.value;
      SDIRTY=true;
      if(STMR)clearTimeout(STMR);
      STMR=setTimeout(function(){saveSheet(true);},1800);
    };
    inp.onkeydown=function(e){
      var rr=parseInt(inp.dataset.r,10),cc=parseInt(inp.dataset.c,10),t=null;
      if(e.key==="ArrowDown"||e.key==="Enter")t=elST.querySelector('input[data-r="'+(rr+1)+'"][data-c="'+cc+'"]');
      else if(e.key==="ArrowUp")t=elST.querySelector('input[data-r="'+(rr-1)+'"][data-c="'+cc+'"]');
      else if(e.key==="Tab"){e.preventDefault();
        t=elST.querySelector('input[data-r="'+rr+'"][data-c="'+(e.shiftKey?cc-1:cc+1)+'"]');}
      if(t){e.preventDefault();t.focus();t.select();}
    };
    inp.onfocus=function(){elSI.textContent=colName(parseInt(inp.dataset.c,10))+(parseInt(inp.dataset.r,10)+1);};
  });
}
function saveSheet(silent){
  if(!CUR)return Promise.resolve();
  return post({action:"save_note",name:CUR,sheet_data:JSON.stringify(SHEET)}).then(function(){
    SDIRTY=false;stat(silent?"sheet saved":"sheet saved "+new Date().toLocaleTimeString());

var TMR_TASK=null,TMR_NAME="",TMR_SEC=0,TMR_RUN=false,TMR_INT=null;
var elTW=document.getElementById("tk-timer"),elTV=document.getElementById("tk-tv"),
    elTT=document.getElementById("tk-tt");
function hms(s){
  var hh=Math.floor(s/3600),mm=Math.floor((s%3600)/60),ss=s%60;
  function p(x){return (x<10?"0":"")+x;}
  return hh+":"+p(mm)+":"+p(ss);
}
function timerTick(){
  if(!TMR_RUN)return;
  TMR_SEC++;
  elTV.textContent=hms(TMR_SEC);
  try{localStorage.setItem("tn_timer",JSON.stringify({t:TMR_TASK,n:TMR_NAME,s:TMR_SEC}));}catch(e){}
}
function timerStart(n,label){
  if(TMR_TASK&&TMR_TASK!==n){
    if(!confirm("A timer is already running for \""+TMR_NAME+"\".\n\nStop it and save the time first?"))return;
    timerStop();
  }
  TMR_TASK=n;TMR_NAME=label;
  if(!TMR_INT)TMR_INT=setInterval(timerTick,1000);
  TMR_RUN=true;
  elTT.textContent=label;
  elTV.textContent=hms(TMR_SEC);
  elTW.classList.add("on","run");
  document.getElementById("tk-tpause").innerHTML="❚❚ Pause";
  stat("timer started");
}
function timerPause(){
  TMR_RUN=!TMR_RUN;
  elTW.classList.toggle("run",TMR_RUN);
  document.getElementById("tk-tpause").innerHTML=TMR_RUN?"❚❚ Pause":"▶ Resume";
  stat(TMR_RUN?"timer resumed":"timer paused");
}
function timerStop(){
  if(!TMR_TASK)return;
  var mins=Math.round(TMR_SEC/60);
  var tsk=TMR_TASK;
  TMR_RUN=false;
  elTW.classList.remove("on","run");
  if(TMR_INT){clearInterval(TMR_INT);TMR_INT=null;}
  try{localStorage.removeItem("tn_timer");}catch(e){}
  TMR_TASK=null;TMR_SEC=0;
  if(mins>0){
    tpost({action:"add_time",name:tsk,minutes:mins}).then(function(m){
      stat("added "+mins+" min (total "+m.time_spent+")");
      loadTasks(CURT);
    }).catch(function(e){stat("timer save error: "+e.message);});
  }else{
    stat("timer stopped (under a minute, not saved)");
  }
}

function tblAct(a,tbl,row,ci){
  var rows=tbl.rows, nc=row.children.length, i, nr, td;
  if(a==="ra"||a==="rb"){
    nr=document.createElement("tr");
    for(i=0;i<nc;i++){td=document.createElement("td");td.innerHTML="<br>";nr.appendChild(td);}
    if(a==="ra")row.parentNode.insertBefore(nr,row);
    else row.parentNode.insertBefore(nr,row.nextSibling);
    stat("row added");
  }else if(a==="cl"||a==="cr"){
    for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
      var c0=rows[i].children[ci];
      var isH=c0&&c0.tagName==="TH";
      td=document.createElement(isH?"th":"td");
      td.innerHTML=isH?"col":"<br>";
      if(a==="cl")rows[i].insertBefore(td,rows[i].children[ci]||null);
      else rows[i].insertBefore(td,(rows[i].children[ci]||{}).nextSibling||null);
    }
    stat("column added");
  }else if(a==="dr"){
    if(rows.length<=1){tbl.parentNode.removeChild(tbl);stat("table removed");return;}
    row.parentNode.removeChild(row);
    stat("row deleted");
  }else if(a==="dc"){
    if(nc<=1){tbl.parentNode.removeChild(tbl);stat("table removed");return;}
    for(i=0;i<rows.length;i++){
      var x=rows[i].children[ci];
      if(x)rows[i].removeChild(x);
    }
    stat("column deleted");
  }else if(a==="dt"){
    if(!confirm("Delete this whole table?"))return;
    tbl.parentNode.removeChild(tbl);
    stat("table deleted");
  }
}

function loadNotebooks(pick){
  get({action:"list_notebooks"}).then(function(m){
    var ns=m.notebooks||[];elNB.innerHTML="";
    ns.forEach(function(n){
      var o=document.createElement("option");o.value=n.name;
      o.textContent=(n.lock_enabled?"\u{1F512} ":"")+n.notebook_name;
      elNB.appendChild(o);});
    if(!ns.length){elTree.innerHTML='<div id="tn-empty">no notebooks — click + Notebook</div>';NB="";return;}
    NB=pick||(localStorage.getItem("tn_nb")||"")||ns[0].name;
    if(!ns.some(function(n){return n.name===NB;}))NB=ns[0].name;
    elNB.value=NB;try{localStorage.setItem("tn_nb",NB);}catch(e){}
    var lk=0;
    ns.forEach(function(n){
      if(n.name===NB){NBWRITE=n.can_write===undefined?1:n.can_write;NBOWNER=n.is_owner||0;lk=n.lock_enabled||0;}
    });
    applyRights();
    if(lk){
      var t0=getTok(NB);
      if(!t0){showLockWall();return;}
      get({action:"lock_status",notebook:NB}).then(function(lm){
        if(!lm.unlocked){setTok(NB,"");showLockWall();return;}
        hideLockWall();
        CUR=null;CURP="";elEd.innerHTML="";LINKS=[];renderLinks();
        loadRoots();stat("ready");
      }).catch(function(){setTok(NB,"");showLockWall();});
      return;
    }
    hideLockWall();
    CUR=null;CURP="";elEd.innerHTML="";LINKS=[];renderLinks();
    loadRoots();stat("ready");
  }).catch(function(e){stat("notebook load error: "+e.message);});
}

var elBody=document.getElementById("tn-body");
function isMobile(){return window.matchMedia("(max-width:820px)").matches;}
function setPane(p){
  elBody.classList.remove("pane-tree","pane-note","pane-att");
  elBody.classList.add("pane-"+p);
  document.querySelectorAll("#tn-tabs button").forEach(function(b){
    b.classList.toggle("on",b.dataset.pane===p);
  });
}

  b.onclick=function(){setPane(b.dataset.pane);};
});
function applyMode(){
  var b=document.getElementById("tn-medit");
  if(isMobile()){
    if(!elBody.classList.contains("pane-tree")&&!elBody.classList.contains("pane-note")&&
       !elBody.classList.contains("pane-att"))setPane("tree");
    var want="0";
    try{want=localStorage.getItem("tn_edit")||"0";}catch(e){}
    if(want==="1"&&CUR){
      elBody.classList.add("edit-on");
      elEd.setAttribute("contenteditable","true");
      b.classList.add("on");
    }else{
      elBody.classList.remove("edit-on");
      elEd.setAttribute("contenteditable","false");
      b.classList.remove("on");
    }
  }else{
    elBody.classList.remove("pane-tree","pane-note","pane-att","edit-on");
    elEd.setAttribute("contenteditable","true");
    b.classList.remove("on");
  }
}
window.addEventListener("resize",applyMode);

function setEdit(on,quiet){
  var b=document.getElementById("tn-medit");
  if(on){
    if(!CUR){stat("select a note first");return;}
    elBody.classList.add("edit-on");
    elEd.setAttribute("contenteditable","true");
    b.classList.add("on");
    try{localStorage.setItem("tn_edit","1");}catch(e){}
    if(isMobile())setPane("note");
    if(!quiet)stat("editing enabled");
  }else{
    elBody.classList.remove("edit-on");
    elEd.setAttribute("contenteditable","false");
    b.classList.remove("on");
    try{localStorage.setItem("tn_edit","0");}catch(e){}
    if(DIRTY)saveNow(false);
    else if(!quiet)stat("read-only");
  }
}

function resizer(handleId,paneId,fromLeft){
  var d=document.getElementById(handleId),p=document.getElementById(paneId),on=false;
  d.onmousedown=function(e){on=true;e.preventDefault();};
  document.addEventListener("mousemove",function(e){
    if(!on)return;
    var w=fromLeft?(e.clientX-p.getBoundingClientRect().left):(p.getBoundingClientRect().right-e.clientX);
    if(w>150&&w<700)p.style.width=w+"px";
  });
  document.addEventListener("mouseup",function(){on=false;});
}
